title: Jewelry & Precious Metals — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Jewelry & Precious Metals Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

productName.title: Product Name
productName.description: Commercial name or trade designation of the jewelry item

productCategory.title: Product Category
productCategory.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — so this field is anticipated, not required. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

gemstoneType.title: Gemstone Type
gemstoneType.description: Type of the primary gemstone set in the jewelry

gemstoneWeight.title: Gemstone Weight
gemstoneWeight.description: Weight of the gemstone in carats

gemstoneColor.title: Gemstone Color
gemstoneColor.description: Color grade of the gemstone (e.g. D-Z for diamonds, or descriptive for colored stones)

gemstoneClarity.title: Gemstone Clarity
gemstoneClarity.description: Clarity grade of the gemstone (e.g. FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, SI1, SI2, I1, I2, I3 for diamonds)

gemstoneCut.title: Gemstone Cut
gemstoneCut.description: Cut grade or shape of the gemstone (for diamonds: Excellent/Very Good/Good/Fair/Poor)

gemstoneOrigin.title: Gemstone Origin
gemstoneOrigin.description: Country where the gemstone was mined

gemstoneTreatment.title: Gemstone Treatment
gemstoneTreatment.description: Any treatment applied to the gemstone to enhance appearance

gemstoneLabCertificate.title: Gemstone Lab Certificate
gemstoneLabCertificate.description: Gemological laboratory certificate number and URL (GIA, IGI, AGS, etc.)

isNatural.title: Is Natural
isNatural.description: Whether the gemstone is natural (mined) or synthetic (lab-grown)
isNatural.x-standard: CIBJO Blue Books; FTC Jewelry Guides

metalOriginCountry.title: Metal Origin Country
metalOriginCountry.description: Country where the precious metal was mined or refined
metalOriginCountry.x-citationNote: Reg (EU) 2017/821 binds UNION IMPORTERS of tin, tantalum, tungsten and gold above the Annex I volume thresholds, requiring supply-chain due diligence. It is not a per-product origin attestation on finished jewellery, and the duty holder is the importer of the mineral rather than the jeweller.

gemstoneOriginMine.title: Gemstone Origin Mine
gemstoneOriginMine.description: Specific mine where the gemstone was extracted, if known

conflictFreeStatus.title: Conflict-Free Status
conflictFreeStatus.description: Whether the materials comply with EU Conflict Minerals Regulation
conflictFreeStatus.x-provision: Art. 3 (binds Union importers of tin, tantalum, tungsten and gold above Annex I volume thresholds)
conflictFreeStatus.x-citationNote: Reg (EU) 2017/821 imposes supply-chain due diligence on Union IMPORTERS of 3TG above Annex I volume thresholds — not a per-product attestation on finished jewellery. Collect where you have it; it does not discharge the importer's duty.

kimberleyProcessCompliant.title: Kimberley Process Compliant
kimberleyProcessCompliant.description: Whether diamonds comply with the Kimberley Process Certification Scheme

fairminedCertified.title: Fairmined Certified
fairminedCertified.description: Whether the gold is Fairmined certified (artisanal and small-scale mining standard)
fairminedCertified.x-standard: Fairmined Standard (voluntary, artisanal and small-scale mining)

rjcCertificationStatus.title: RJC Certification Status
rjcCertificationStatus.description: Responsible Jewellery Council certification status (COP or COC)
rjcCertificationStatus.x-standard: RJC Code of Practices; RJC Chain of Custody

chainOfCustodyDocUrl.title: Chain of Custody Document URL
chainOfCustodyDocUrl.description: URL to the chain of custody documentation proving traceability

leadContent.title: Lead Content
leadContent.description: Lead content in parts per million — must be below 500 ppm per REACH
leadContent.x-provision: Annex XVII Entry 63 (metal parts of jewellery: max 0.05% w/w)
leadContent.x-citationNote: A market-placement restriction: jewellery metal parts must not exceed 0.05% w/w lead. The duty is to stay under the limit and hold the evidence, not to publish the measured value.

cadmiumContent.title: Cadmium Content
cadmiumContent.description: Cadmium content in parts per million — must be below 100 ppm per REACH
cadmiumContent.x-citationNote: A market-placement restriction: max 0.01% w/w cadmium. The duty is to stay under the limit and hold the evidence, not to publish the measured value.

nickelMigrationRate.title: Nickel Migration Rate
nickelMigrationRate.description: Nickel migration rate — must be < 0.2 ug/cm2/week for piercing jewelry, < 0.5 for prolonged skin contact
nickelMigrationRate.x-provision: Annex XVII Entry 27 (skin contact: <0.5 µg/cm²/week; body piercing: <0.2 µg/cm²/week)
nickelMigrationRate.x-citationNote: A market-placement restriction, conditional on prolonged skin contact or body piercing. The duty is to stay under the migration limit and hold the evidence, not to publish the measured rate.

svhcPresent.title: SVHC Present
svhcPresent.description: Whether Substances of Very High Concern are present above 0.1% w/w
svhcPresent.x-provision: Art. 33(2) (on request, within 45 days, above 0.1% w/w; minimum content is the substance name)
svhcPresent.x-citationNote: REACH Art. 33 is an ON-REQUEST duty above 0.1% w/w, answered within 45 days with at minimum the substance name — not proactive publication. Holding this makes answering a request fast; it is not itself the discharge.

reachTestReportUrl.title: REACH Test Report URL
reachTestReportUrl.description: URL to the REACH compliance test report
reachTestReportUrl.x-citationNote: REACH restrictions relevant to jewellery — lead, cadmium and nickel release under Annex XVII — are market-placement limits. Compliance is demonstrated by staying within them and holding the test evidence for authorities; REACH requires no publication of test reports.
